notes: Recorded as fails-quota for two independent reasons, and both are quoted rather than inferred. The product cannot be bought: the group page reads '0 可用' on both plans and the cart returns '缺货 目前该项目缺货' (out of stock, ordering suspended). And the traffic term is the tightest at 500 GB counted in both directions, which halves the usable outbound budget against sellers that count one way. The row is still worth keeping because it is the only Taiwan HINET ISP-line NAT product found, the price is USD 1.00 a month for 512 MB, and 20 IPv4 ports plus a dedicated IPv6 is a good port story. What is not established: whether it ever restocks, the registration fields, the payment rails and the legal entity. WAPAC has no standalone registration form - it creates the account at checkout - so with the product out of stock there was no route to the checkout fields at all. The tengine default 404 page leaks a host name in the ip51.net range, which is infrastructure detail and not an entity. A restock check would settle availability; that is the one thing worth re-running on this row.
